tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Cambium Networks 5GHz PTP 550 Connectorized 1.4 Gbps Point-to-Point Backhaul Radio Link

Cambium Network is excited to introduce our latest Point to Point Gigabit throughput solution based on 802.11 ac Wave 2 operating in 5 GHz wireless space, addressing the gigabit capacity needs for high speed backhaul solutions in mid range and long range applications.

The Cambium Networks PTP 550 is a high-performance, connectorized 5GHz Point-to-Point (PTP) backhaul radio designed to deliver up to 1.4 Gbps aggregate throughput. Built on 802.11ac Wave 2 technology, the PTP 550 supports dual radios, channel bonding, and dynamic spectrum optimization to ensure maximum link stability and performance, even in high-interference environments.

The connectorized version gives network operators the flexibility to choose the right external antennas (e.g., 2 ft or 3 ft parabolic dishes) based on distance and deployment scenario, making it ideal for long-range wireless bridging, ISP backhauls, and enterprise or surveillance links across Bangladesh.


Key Features:

  • Operating Frequency: 4.9 – 6.2 GHz

  • Throughput: Up to 1.4 Gbps aggregate

  • Dual-radio operation (2 x 80 MHz channels)

  • Connectorized: supports external high-gain antennas

  • 802.11ac Wave 2 with 2x2 MIMO

  • Dynamic Channel Selection for Interference Avoidance

  • AES 128 encryption for secure links

  • IP66/67 ruggedized outdoor enclosure

  • Integrated GUI and LinkPlanner support


Link Distance:

  • Maximum Distance: Up to 100+ km (with large dish antennas and clear LOS)

  • Typical Stable Link: 10–60 km, depending on terrain and antenna gain


Ideal Applications:

  • Wireless ISP backbone

  • High-capacity enterprise connectivity

  • Video surveillance backhaul

  • Rural broadband extension
